project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra slim keyboard fit poster

main_subject.detail: Minimal product poster showing the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra mounted on a Book Cover Keyboard Slim in a side profile that emphasizes thinness and a sleek laptop-like silhouette.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic minimalist product render, clean accessory ecosystem hero shot

composition_elements.text: A sleek fit for a slim tablet / Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra
items: Top Left: Large centered black title 'A sleek fit for a slim tablet'.
Top Right: Smaller centered subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra'.
Bottom Left: Small gray footnotes stating '*Book Cover Keyboard Slim sold separately.' and '*Image simulated for illustrative purposes. Actual UI may differ.'
Bottom Right: Clean empty off-white negative space.
Center/Background: Graphite Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra in profile on a dark gray keyboard base with kickstand, showing a thin side frame and pink abstract wallpaper on screen.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle matte highlights, light shadow grounding, crisp hardware edges, airy premium ecommerce mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra slim keyboard fit poster. Centerpiece is a side-profile Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra mounted on a dark Book Cover Keyboard Slim, showing an ultra-thin silhouette and a soft pink display wallpaper. Background is an off-white minimal ecommerce field with generous negative space. Surrounding elements: exact title 'A sleek fit for a slim tablet', subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra', and tiny gray disclaimers about the keyboard being sold separately and image simulation at the bottom left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, gentle matte highlights and crisp hardware edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
